blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call +91-40-4633-1111 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.

blocking_methods.label: alternate
blocking_methods.instructions: Call +91-22-4672-0000 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Email customercare@adcbindia.com from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://www.adcbindia.com and use the card block/hotlist option.
Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.adcb.mobilebanking | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/adcb-mobile/id1189468144
